_comment: Live eval design for the #346 review panel. Stage A profiles single models; Stage B screens panel compositions by simulation (simulate.py); Stage C confirms the shortlist end to end. Slots use the review-panel/1 vocabulary (tier, count, strategy); a slot may pin models with 'models' for the simulator and for eval-only tier files (render.py writes them). tier2b models (2026-11-11): gpt-6.1-terra, glm-5.3, Qwen3.8-max, muse-wonder-1.0; the gateway alias must exist before a t2b panel runs live.

models.note: bridge to every earlier experiment (the stand-in model); keep so live numbers can be compared with the Haiku data
optional, expensive; profile only if the owner approves

stage_a.task: first-round review of spec S1 (prompts/01-stage-a-reviewer.md), report only, no revision
stage_a.output: one findings report per (model, rep); matcher maps findings to ledger defects D01-D44 (prompts/02-stage-a-matcher.md)
also_record: the model id the gateway actually served (not the requested alias)

panels.why: is the weak budget tier worth its two slots?
same size as live7, the two t4 slots become t3
a second frontier reviewer (random tier 1b) instead of a t4 pair
cost-matched to 3 Sonnet + 3 cheap (the pn1m shape): three frontier plus three cheap
tier 2 only for the parallel reviewers

stage_b.also: run with --enumerate 5, 6, 7 and 8 to rank every multiset of profiled models; add the top 3 per size that are expressible as a review-panel/1 template (one fixed slot, counts 1..4, total 1..8) to the Stage C list
stage_b.shortlist_rule: carry to Stage C: C0, C1 (or the nearest runnable panel), the 3 best simulated panels by E[fixed], and the best simulated panel at or below C0's token cost

stage_c.pre_registered_order: blocked randomization, one run of every shortlisted panel per block, order shuffled inside each block with the seed in the run file
stage_c.equal_concurrency: hold the number of runs in flight constant (the replicate used 12); record launch time and slot index per run
stage_c.pipeline: the PN1 loop: first-round panel, merge, typed ledger, adjudicator (Sonnet), revise, re-review, up to 3 rounds, then two audits
stage_c.scoring: blind Sonnet scorers on the 44-defect ledger (p17/score/prompt-template.md), sids shuffled; Opus 5.5 rescore of the 2 highest and 2 lowest specs only

decision_rule.adopt: the cheapest panel whose mean fixed is within 1.0 of the best shortlisted panel and at least 2.0 above C0 with permutation p < 0.10 against C0 (pooled over replicates of the same panel)
decision_rule.otherwise: keep C0 and report the table
decision_rule.never: choose on cost alone, or on fewer than 6 scored runs per panel
